title: Animation Mask
description: Defines how the parent animation attenuates a target animation's weight.

target.description: The index of the target animation whose weight this mask attenuates.

type.description: The type of the mask. 'blend' reduces the target proportionally to this animation's weight. 'block' fully reduces the target by the amount when this animation's weight exceeds the threshold.

amount.description: The amount of influence this mask has on the target animation. A value of 1.0 means full influence.

threshold.description: For 'block' type masks, the weight above which the target animation is blocked. When this animation's weight exceeds the threshold, the target is reduced by the amount.
